Daily Economic Briefing

Monday, 27 July 2026

MOVE 77.21SOFR 3.64%NFCI -0.552Durable Goods 08:30 ETTreasury 11:30 / 13:00FOMC Tomorrow
Liquidity & Stress Metrics - The Gnosis Pulse
MetricValueMarket Context
MOVE Index77.21ICE BofA MOVE is Treasury volatility and term-premium stress. Gnosis bands: below 80 calm bond markets and stable policy expectations, 80-120 moderate uncertainty typical around Fed meetings, 150+ high stress. At 77.21 (27 Jul, Yahoo Finance ^MOVE) bonds still price a calm FOMC, but the index is up from 70.88 on 17 Jul, so event premium is building.
SOFR Rate3.64%SOFR is secured overnight funding plumbing. It drifted 3.57% to 3.64% through last week (NY Fed, latest print 24 Jul), pressing the top of the 3.50-3.75% funds target range. No stress signal, but month-end funding into FOMC deserves a watch.
NFCI-0.552Chicago Fed NFCI is broad financial conditions: zero is average since 1971, negative and falling means looser, positive means tighter. At -0.55 for the week ending 17 Jul it is the loosest reading in years and a 1-2 quarter leading tailwind for growth.
Gnosis Interpretation
Nothing stops this train, with a hint of caution: financial conditions are the loosest in years, funding is orderly, and bond volatility below 80 says the market expects a quiet Fed. The caution is that MOVE is rising into the decision and SOFR is leaning on the top of the target range, so the calm is priced, not guaranteed.

No NYSE holiday or shortened session was verified for today, and no standard equity-index options expiry falls on 27 Jul. Week ahead: FOMC meets 28-29 Jul with the decision Wednesday 14:00 ET (Fed calendar verified), GDP advance Q2 and June Personal Income/PCE land Thursday 08:30 ET (BEA schedule verified), and the Employment Cost Index closes the week Friday 08:30 ET (BLS).
Trading Strategy Note (ES Futures)
Base case: With this morning's releases printed and supply absorbed, ES trades on FOMC positioning: loose conditions, calm MOVE below 80, and an oil-driven inflation relief bid support the drift, with 7,445-7,450 as the first resistance zone to reclaim.
Invalidation: If MOVE pushes through 80 into the 80-120 uncertainty band or SOFR pressure spills into repo, treat the calm-Fed pricing as crowded and cut exposure ahead of Wednesday 14:00 ET. A hawkish surprise against 3.4% core PCE inflation is the macro risk this calm tape is underpricing.
